question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Back out
solution:
The correct answer is** 'To withdraw'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given phrasal verb** 'Back out' **is **'To withdraw'.**
 
• **Back out:** withdraw from a commitment. (एक प्रतिबद्धता से पीछे हटना)
 
 
• *Example: If he **backs out** of the deal they'll sue him.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To withdraw.*
